## Blog

Articles on AI context engineering, token optimization, and developer tooling:

- [AI Context Engineering Stack](https://zainraza.dev/blog/ai-context-engineering-stack-token-optimization): Cutting token usage across the agent pipeline
- [The Caveman Protocol](https://zainraza.dev/blog/caveman-protocol-token-reduction): A simple rule that slashes AI token usage
- [Hooks for AI Context Enforcement](https://zainraza.dev/blog/hooks-ai-context-enforcement): Enforcement layer for token optimization
- [Semble](https://zainraza.dev/blog/semble-code-search-token-optimization): Semantic code retrieval instead of grep-and-read
- [Code Review Graph](https://zainraza.dev/blog/code-review-graph-context-optimization): Reviewing impact, not files
- [Context Mode](https://zainraza.dev/blog/context-mode-context-virtualization): Scaling AI without scaling context
- [Context-Mode MCP Firewall](https://zainraza.dev/blog/context-mode-mcp-context-firewall): Sandboxing tool output for AI agents
- [.cursorignore](https://zainraza.dev/blog/cursorignore-token-optimization): Excluding irrelevant files from AI indexing
- [Prompt Caching](https://zainraza.dev/blog/prompt-caching-ai-token-optimization): Reusing intelligence instead of recomputing it
- [RTK (Rust Token Killer)](https://zainraza.dev/blog/rtk-rust-token-killer-cli-compression): Compressing CLI noise before it hits context
